detailed_descriptions.en: RMS Lusitania - a legend in history - was torpedoed and sunk in 1915 at the height of the Great War. But now Lusitania has resurfaced digitally for SHIP EXPLORER in an exciting new virtual experience. In 'A MONARCH FALLEN' you will explore Lusitania from construction to destruction as the ship herself becomes a virtual museum. Walk Lusitania's decks once more as the ship glides across the Atlantic in peace or war - or explore under her waterline in the drydock. Interact with dozens of information points to find out how the great transatlantic 'greyhound' won the speed record and became a favorite on the most glamorous route in the world. Explorer rare and authentic historical documents provided by the Lusitania and Old Head Signal Tower of Kinsale, Ireland Control the weather and the time to get the perfect angle with photo mode and recrate some of your favorite photographs from on board or in 3rd person. Access a selection of spaces from the ship's interior across all three passenger classes - see Lusitania from angles she hasn't been seen from since 1915. Rewind the clock and experience Lusitania's final moments during her sinking - find out all about the tragic series of events that led to her loss and experience Lusitania's final-plunge firsthand. This is Lusitania in living, breathing colour!
